titles.romaji: Amada Anime Series: Super Mario Brothers
titles.native: アマダアニメシリーズ スーパーマリオブラザーズ

description:
Amada Anime Series: Super Mario Bros is a trilogy of OVAs based on traditional fairy tales. They were released only in Japan in 1989.

Includes:
• Super Mario's Momotarou (based on Momotarou)
• Super Mario's Issun-boushi (based on Issun-boushi)
• Super Mario's Shirayuki-hime (based on Snow White)
